Congruence predicates

request.text:
Congruence predicates
\(x\equiv r\pmod m\), one unary predicate for each fixed modulus \(m\geq1\)
and residue \(0\leq r<m\), may be added as definitional expansions for
quantifier elimination; each is introduced by the explicit definition
\(\exists y\,(x=\underline r+m\cdot y)\) of
\cref{def:p01-w02b-p01-013-congruence-predicate}, and
\cref{thm:p01-w02b-p01-013-congruence-definable} shows that the expansion is
conservative.
request.reason: S-003-C04 / A-168-C02: the congruence predicate is used without a typed definition at its first use; the gloss fixes the operand types (object-language term, fixed numerals m and r) and links the registered role in handbook/registry/symbols-intake-p01-notation-binding-and-comparison-of-formal-w02b-p01-013.csv.
